full_prompt_en: A square painterly illustration looks down over a small town nestled among bare trees at blue dusk. A pale winding path enters from the lower right, sweeps left through the lower center, and bends back toward the houses. One tiny dark person walks near its foreground curve, casting a long thin shadow across the path; a few small dark birds stand farther along it. The hills on either side are covered in warm copper-red fallen foliage, while narrow black trunks rise in dense rows along the left slope and scatter more lightly to the right. In the middle distance, tightly packed houses step down a valley. Their walls shift among muted teal, dusty red, ocher, and blue, and many small rectangular windows glow buttery yellow. Behind them, an even paler ridge carries a simple pointed tower and low dark treetops. High in the left sky, a small creamy moon is softened by turquoise mist. The town's edges are delicate, partly swallowed by atmosphere, whereas the near trunks and walking figure are dark and crisp. Fine speckle across the hills and sky makes the colors feel lightly granular, with no hard glossy surface. The elevated viewpoint lets the bright path serve as a visual route through the darker slope into the warm lights of the buildings. Illumination combines cool diffuse twilight from the upper sky with gentle amber light from windows and pockets among the trees; shadows stretch softly rather than cutting with a hard edge. No readable text is visible. The overall composition is hushed and storylike, using the path's curve and many small warm lights to draw the eye through a cool, spacious evening.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形绘画式插画从高处俯视蓝色暮光中的小镇，镇子坐落在光秃树林之间。一条浅色弯路从右下进入，经过下方中央向左扫去，再回弯通往房屋。一名极小的深色行人在近处弯道上行走，细长影子横落在路面；稍远处还有几只深色小鸟立在路上。两侧山坡覆着暖铜红色落叶，左坡密集的窄黑树干排排竖起，右侧则更零散。中景的房屋在谷地里紧密层叠。墙面在低调青绿、灰红、赭色和蓝色间变化，许多小矩形窗透出奶油黄色暖光。房屋后方更浅的山脊上有一座简单尖塔和低矮深色树梢。左上天空里，一轮小小的奶油色月亮被青绿雾气柔化。小镇的边缘纤细，局部被空气吞没，近处树干与行人却深而清晰。山坡与天空的细点纹让颜色略带颗粒，没有坚硬光滑的表面。升高的视点让亮路成为视觉路线，带目光穿过深色坡面进入建筑群的暖光。照明结合上方天空的冷色散射暮光与窗内、林间的温柔琥珀光；影子柔软拉长，而非硬边切出。没有可读文字。整体构图安静而像故事，以道路弧线和众多微小暖灯引导目光穿过冷而宽阔的夜色。
style_prompt_en: The image has a softly painted storybook finish with fine granular color and gently dissolving distant edges. Cool turquoise, slate blue, and muted green spread over the broad atmosphere, while copper, russet, and small golden lights form warm islands within it. Thin dark vertical strokes punctuate rounded color masses, and a broad pale curve guides attention from the lower frame into the depth. The texture resembles dry speckle over soft blended paint; forms remain legible without sharp mechanical outlines. Twilight provides even cool illumination, and many tiny warm points create local glow rather than one dominant beam. An elevated view compresses layered planes, with closer dark marks gradually giving way to paler haze. The overall effect is quiet, lyrical, and inviting, balancing empty cool air against small concentrated accents of warmth.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有柔软绘成的故事书质感，色彩带细颗粒，远处边缘轻轻消散。冷青绿、石板蓝和低调绿铺展于宽阔空气中，铜色、赭红及小小金色亮点在其中形成温暖岛屿。细深色竖笔划点缀圆浑色团，宽浅色弧线把注意力从下方引入纵深。纹理像柔和晕染颜料上的干点纹；形体仍能辨认，却没有机械硬边。暮光提供均匀冷照明，众多微小暖点制造局部光晕，而非单一主光束。升高视点压缩层叠平面，近处深色笔迹渐渐让位于浅淡雾气。整体效果安静、抒情且引人靠近，以冷色空旷空气平衡集中的少量暖色强调。
theme_en: A lone walker on a curving pale path above a softly glowing town at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色中一名独行者走在发光小镇上方的浅色弯曲小路上
name: Nicholas Hely Hutchinson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
